# Races

Offsets are applied to the base stat value of 10.

| Race | Size | STR | DEX | CON | INT | WIS |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Human | Medium | – | – | – | – | – |
| Dwarf | Medium | +6 | -4 | +8 | – | +2 |
| Elf | Medium | -4 | +4 | -6 | +8 | +4 |
| Goblin | Small | -4 | +6 | – | +2 | – |
| Ogre | Large | +10 | -6 | +10 | -8 | -4 |
